## Highlights

- Cargo builds now compile only the binaries selected by the project packaging manifest (`nfpm`) or Cargo metadata. Unrelated workspace tools and galleries are not built or packaged.
- This removes workspace-wide feature unification and brings package sizes closer to native packaging.

## Changes

- Reuse the nfpm/Cargo selection for the build step, with a full-workspace fallback when the targeted build fails.
- Validate the scope with a synthetic Cargo workspace: only the selected application binaries were built and packaged.
- Document that source-archive and local-directory input is deferred to `v0.2.0-beta.1`.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hyalcin70/git2pkg/compare/v0.2.0-alpha.33...v0.2.0-alpha.34
